rationale: Revised plan addresses three evaluation failures identified in feedback: (1) financial_summary statistics changed from 'sum_mean' to 'sum_mean_quantiles' to include distribution quantiles (median, p90, p99) for skewed amount columns, meeting the 'paid_amount.p90' requirement and providing full statistical context; (2) write_report show_denominators changed from false to true to display every rate in 'numerator / denominator = rate' format, resolving both the show_denominators check and denominator_format check by enforcing transparent rate presentation throughout the report. All other components remain unchanged.
changes_summary: Two parameter corrections: (1) financial_summary statistics 'sum_mean' → 'sum_mean_quantiles' to include median, p90, p99 quantiles for billed_amount, allowed_amount, and paid_amount; (2) write_report show_denominators false → true to display all rates as 'numerator / denominator = rate' format for statistical transparency.
